summary: US and Saudi forces conducted joint strikes targeting pro-Iran militias in eastern Iraq, killing at least six Iranian military advisors and 20 IRGC personnel. Trump stated Iran knows the US will attack today and vowed to hit hard despite Iranian appeals. Meanwhile, Israel demolished a Hezbollah command center in southern Lebanon and maintains high alert for potential escalation.
key_points: US-Saudi joint strikes hit Popular Mobilization Forces bases in Diyala, Kirkuk, Karbala, and Nineveh provinces, killing Iranian advisors. (Source: @VahidOnline/77615)
Trump declared Iranians know US will attack today, saying "It's our turn. We'll hit them hard." (Source: @almogboker78/17850)
Israeli army demolished underground Hezbollah command center in Haddatha, uncovering 55-meter tunnel 300 meters from UNIFIL. (Source: @manniefabian/58882)
Netanyahu presented Trump with three options on Iran: deal, maritime blockade, or intensified military strikes. (Source: @VahidOnline/77623)
US Senate advanced bill extending Iran sanctions to 2031; OFAC sanctioned 10 companies and 8 tankers linked to Iran. (Source: @VahidOnline/77614)
Drone struck US-owned gas storage vessel at Egypt's Damietta LNG terminal, causing fire on two ships. (Source: @VahidOnline/77621)
IDF Chief of Staff in South Lebanon vowed to reach additional areas if required and not withdraw until long-term security assured. (Source: @amitsegal/63498)
Iraq's Coordination Framework held emergency meeting over US-Saudi strikes on sovereignty. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381830)

sections.executive_summary: US and Saudi forces conducted joint strikes targeting pro-Iran militias in eastern Iraq, killing at least six Iranian military advisors and 20 IRGC personnel. Trump stated Iran knows the US will attack today and vowed to hit hard despite Iranian appeals. Meanwhile, Israel demolished a Hezbollah command center in southern Lebanon and maintains high alert for potential escalation.

points: Iran faces extended US sanctions to 2031 after Senate 86-12 vote; OFAC designated 10 companies and 8 tankers including Hormozsaf Marine Services and Persian Gulf Marine Insurance registered in Hong Kong, Marshall Islands, China. (Source: @VahidOnline/77614)

Trump claimed Iran apologized via a "different group" but vowed to strike hard; separately stated Iranians know US will attack today and they asked US not to. (Source: @SharghDaily/175184, @almogboker78/17850)

At least six Iranian military advisors killed in US-Saudi joint strikes on Iraqi militia bases across Diyala, Kirkuk, Karbala, Nineveh; US official cited 20 technical advisors and IRGC members killed. (Source: @asafroz/52063, @rodast_omiddana/78116)

Netanyahu informed Trump Iran seeks to leverage Strait of Hormuz; Bloomberg assessed US-Iran conflict there could last months without decisive outcome. (Source: @VahidOnline/77623, @SharghDaily/175175)

Internal Iranian divisions reported: economic hardship causing protests, leadership split between collapse fears and hardline confidence in weapons control; Mojtaba Khamenei's status unverified. (Source: @VahidOnline/77623)

Netanyahu-Trump meeting covered three Iran options: nuclear deal, maritime blockade with economic pressure, or resumed/intensified military strikes; Netanyahu doubted deal viability. (Source: @VahidOnline/77623)
Netanyahu presented Syria map showing Turkey controls 5% of Syria (50x Israel's 0.1%); asserted Israel will keep southern buffer zone while jihadi threat exists. (Source: @VahidOnline/77623)
Israel seeks 10-year plan to reduce US military aid to zero, develop indigenous fighter jet, and establish $16B direct aid plus $5-10B missile defense funding. (Source: @VahidOnline/77623)

IDF demolished Hezbollah command center in Haddatha village: 55-meter tunnel with three rooms under factory, 300m from UNIFIL, nearby weapons pit; engineers destroyed it. (Source: @manniefabian/58882)
IDF Chief of Staff in South Lebanon stated forces will reach additional areas if required and not withdraw until long-term security assured. (Source: @amitsegal/63498)
High alert declared in Israel anticipating potential escalation tonight; explosions possible in Nahariya/Western Galilee from IDF activity. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381850, @N12chat/219863)
Israeli citizen indicted for spying for Iran while serving in classified unit; contacted alleged Iranian intelligence, asked to recruit soldier. (Source: @inon_yttach/9725)
IAF UAV conducted "roof knock" warning strike on building in central Gaza. (Source: @shin_persian/8659)

IDF demolished underground Hezbollah command center in Haddatha, southern Lebanon, inside buffer zone; 55-meter tunnel with three rooms under construction factory, 300m from UNIFIL. (Source: @manniefabian/58882)
Strike reported in Taybeh, South Lebanon. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93967)
IDF Chief of Staff in South Lebanon: "If required - we will reach additional areas. Not withdraw until long-term security assured." (Source: @amitsegal/63498)
Hezbollah command center used for operations; nearby pit contained dozens of weapons; combat engineers blew up tunnel this week. (Source: @manniefabian/58882)

US and Saudi forces jointly struck pro-Iran armed group positions in eastern Iraq overnight, targeting Popular Mobilization Forces bases in Diyala, Kirkuk, Karbala, Nineveh provinces. (Source: @VahidOnline/77615)
At least six Iranian military advisors killed; US official reported 20 technical advisors and IRGC members killed in the strikes. (Source: @asafroz/52063, @rodast_omiddana/78116)
Iraq's Coordination Framework convened emergency meeting at government palace to discuss US-Saudi "attacks on sovereignty." (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381830)
Funeral processions in Basra for Haider Mansour Al-Sakini, killed during "US-Saudi aggression." (Source: @naya_foriraq/86266)
Netanyahu showed Trump map claiming Turkey controls 50x more Syrian territory than Israel; Israel holds 0.1%, Turkey 5%. (Source: @VahidOnline/77623)
Saudi defense minister told Vance that pro-Iran Iraqi militia attacks on Saudi infrastructure and energy facilities crossed a red line, requiring response. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5868)
